title: Phone connection and calling behavior
summary: This topic centers on phone pairing, call handling, and vehicle-connected calling features, but most sampled fragments are too incomplete or contextual to determine a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention convenient automatic phone connection to Android Auto, while the second positive example is too contradictory to cleanly illustrate a favorable call experience.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe suspected unintended call recording or voice-listening behavior and phone issues that required re-pairing, with limited detail in one example.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments reference phone priority, call capability, e-sim calling, cables, and service phone access, but they usually lack enough context to judge satisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined or incomplete, which limits confidence in a more specific thematic summary.
One positive example appears to describe a failed voice-calling function despite its assigned positive label, so the positive evidence is limited and somewhat inconsistent.
Some fragments may refer to dealership or service phone lines rather than in-vehicle phone connectivity, so the cluster may mix related but not identical subjects.
